plan: In a single sealed bid auction with ascending clock, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value. My value is $25, so I want to exit the auction when the price approaches my value. I'll bid around $24.50 to create a buffer. This allows me to potentially win if others bid lower, while protecting my profit margin. The goal is to win only if the final price is significantly below my true value.

Since the winning price will be the second-highest sealed bid, I'll aim to bid around $28-$29 to potentially win while preserving some profit margin.
